items.title: anthropics/claude-code
items.summary: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool
items.detail: It uses natural language commands to execute routine tasks, explain complex code, and handle git workflows, making it a useful tool for developers. This can improve productivity and reduce the time spent on repetitive tasks.

items.title: google/leveldb
items.summary: LevelDB is a fast key-value storage library
items.detail: It provides an ordered mapping from string keys to string values, making it suitable for applications that require fast and efficient data storage and retrieval. LevelDB is written in C++ and has been used in various Google projects.

items.title: p1ngul1n0/blackbird
items.detail: It allows users to search for accounts by username and email in social networks, making it a useful tool for security researchers and investigators. Blackbird can help identify potential security threats and gather information about individuals or organizations.

items.title: pimalaya/himalaya
items.summary: Himalaya is a CLI email manager
items.detail: It provides a command-line interface for managing emails, making it a useful tool for users who prefer a text-based interface. Himalaya can help simplify email management tasks and provide a more efficient way of handling emails.

items.title: pranshuparmar/witr
items.summary: Witr is a process tracing tool
items.detail: It allows users to trace any process, port, container, or file back to what started it, making it a useful tool for debugging and troubleshooting. Witr provides a CLI and TUI interface, making it easy to use and navigate.
